annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Artificial Intelligence for Europe' (COM(2018) 237 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Artificial Intelligence for Europe' (COM(2018) 237 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 440
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's 2018 'Artificial Intelligence for Europe' Communication. It supports EU investment in AI while calling for ethics guidelines, a harmonised mandatory legal framework, revised liability and consumer rules, algorithmic auditing, worker training and social dialogue. Robotics is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a harmonised, mandatory EU legal framework for AI alongside ethics guidelines
Urges review of EU liability, product safety and consumer legislation for AI
Recommends public or independent bodies for algorithmic auditing
Stresses education, training and social dialogue to protect workers
Notes EU strength in automation and robotics deserves specific attention
